Title: Cross-partition ORDER BY queries available in Azure Cosmos DB Java and Node.js SDKs

Body.Content:
The new Azure Cosmos DB Java and Node.js SDKs are available. Both include support for TOP and ORDER BY queries on partitioned collections. You can use TOP and ORDER BY queries to retrieve the top number of results from multiple partitions in your database and order those results based on the property that you specify.

To download the Azure Cosmos DB Java SDK 1.9.0, get the latest release notes, and browse to the API reference content, go to the Azure Cosmos DB Java SDK page.

To download the Azure Cosmos DB Node.js SDK 1.10.0, get the latest release notes, and browse to the API reference content, go to the Azure Cosmos DB Node.js SDK page.
